Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: one landscape product-gallery photograph for PawsStore. Clean matte warm off-white seamless studio backdrop, soft diffused daylight from upper left, very subtle contact shadow, premium authentic ecommerce product photography with tactile materials. The product is the only subject and fills about 72 percent of the frame. No text, graphic overlays, labels, watermarks, people, animals, props, collages or borders. One photograph per output, centered landscape 3:2.
Subject: Airline-approved soft-sided pet travel carrier. Low rectangular duffel with softly rounded corners, charcoal gray woven polyester, black mesh ventilation on long sides and short zippered door, dark gray reinforced piping, two black carry handles with a charcoal padded grip, detachable black shoulder strap, soft pale-gray fleece pad visible faintly through mesh. It accommodates a small pet. Keep this design consistent; the bag has a single compartment and no pockets except a shallow side slip pocket.
View: Front three-quarter angle with the front mesh door closed. Show full bag shape, both side vent and short front door, padded handles neatly held together, shoulder strap folded beside the bag.

Camera and composition: Show the entire exact same carrier from the opposite front three-quarter angle and a little higher, with the short mesh door unzipped, folded flat toward the camera on its bottom hinge, revealing the light gray fleece pad, without moving or redesigning the handles.
